home.headline: Westbrook's sourdough, since 1984.
home.subheadline: A family bakery on Main Street baking bread, pastries and celebration cakes from scratch every morning. Order ahead and we'll have it boxed and ready.
home.final_heading: Come hungry. We'll have something warm.

about.heading: Three generations of early mornings.
paragraphs: The Russo family opened Marigold in 1984 with one oven and a sourdough starter.
Forty years later we still bake everything by hand, before sunrise, right here in Westbrook.
